node.label: Lewy body dementia
node.definition: A progressive form of dementia characterized by the presence of protein deposits called Lewy bodies in the midbrain and cerebral cortex, and loss of cholinergic and dopaminergic neurons. The signs and symptoms overlap with Alzheimer and Parkinson disease.

evidence.snippet: GBA1 is annotated as disease gene of OMIM:127750 (HPO genes_to_phenotype, OMIM-derived)
